_README: RUN-SPECIFIC parameter file for Ex22_SMF (Steltic viewer bundle demonstration, 2026-09-05). Values read from the converted
ANSI/AISC 342-22 and ASCE/SEI 41-23 in C:/steltic/grok/converted/converted_2026-09-05 (pdf pages cited per block).
This file lives with the Ex22 outputs only; the repository copy stays a placeholder because the Grok Bot live-queries the standards.
Table C3.6 column expressions were decoded from a table whose equations the converter flattened -- see 'decode_note'.

material.note: ASTM A992 W-shapes. AISC 342-22 Sec. A5.2a / Table A5.2 (pdf 43): Fye = Ry Fy with Ry from AISC 341-22 Table A3.2 (A992: Ry = 1.1) -> Fye = 55 ksi.

beam_flexure.basis: SMF beams with RBS moment connections conforming to ANSI/AISC 358 -> AISC 342-22 Table C5.5 (pdf 113-114), row 'RBS moment connection in conformance with ANSI/AISC 358 [b][e]': a = X2 <= 0.07, b = 0.07, c = 0.3; IO = 0.5a, LS = 0.75b, CP = b. X2 (note [e]) = 0.55 (h/tw)^-0.5 (bf/2tf)^-0.7 (Lb/ry)^-0.5 (L/d)^0.8. Values apply at the column face (note [a]); modified per Sec. C5.4a.1.a.1(a)-(d), cumulative (C5.4a.2).
beam_flexure.Lb_note: Steltic design bracing Lb = 0.095 E ry / Fy (calc_package inputs Lb_in, Lb/ry = 55.1 for every SMF beam)
beam_flexure.rbs_note: RBS flange cut c = 0.25 bf per beam (AISC 358-22 Sec. 5.8 Step 1 upper limit; Steltic's W40X277 detail c = 4.0 in = 0.25 bf); Z_RBS = Zx - 2 c tbf (d - tbf) (AISC 358-22 Eq. 5.8-4) sets M_CE of the hinge (C5.3a.1(b): M_CE per ANSI/AISC 358)
beam_flexure.Mc_note: capping ratio taken as Cpr = 1.15 (AISC 358 Eq. 2.4.3-2 upper limit) -- modelling assumption, not a Table C5.5 value

modifiers.why: C5.4a.1.a.1(b): V_PZ/V_ye (Eq. C5-21 / C4.3a with Spec. J10.6(a)) outside 0.6-0.9 at most joints -- corner joints 0.3-0.5, interior Y-face joints 1.1-1.4 (no doubler plates); interior X-face joints 0.88-0.93. Applied to all FR hinges (conservative).

modifier_checks.(a) continuity plates: 1 in plates >= tbf/2 (max tbf 1.73 in) and W14 column flanges tcf >= bbf/5.2 -> satisfied, no reduction
modifier_checks.(c) slenderness: all SMF beams highly ductile (bf/2tf <= 0.31 sqrt(E/Fye) = 7.1, h/tw <= 2.45 sqrt(E/Fye) = 56.3) -> no reduction
modifier_checks.(d) clear span / depth: Lcf/db = (360 - dc)/db >= 8.1 for every SMF beam -> no reduction (applies to Table C5.4 m anyway)

beam_flexure.theta_y: AISC 342-22 Eq. C2-2 with eta = 0 (shear deformation not modelled), L_CL = span between column centrelines, M_CE = Z_RBS Fye

table_C2_2_reference.note: beam (member) values, used only if a hinge is NOT an FR connection: highly ductile a = 9 thy, b = 11 thy, c = 0.6; IO 0.25a, LS a, CP b; non-moderately ductile a = 4 thy, b = 6 thy, c = 0.2; IO 0.25a, LS 0.75a, CP a (AISC 342-22 Table C2.2, pdf 62)

column_flexure.basis: AISC 342-22 Table C3.6 (pdf 78, printed 46), 'Columns and braces in compression, 1. highly ductile': a = 5.5 (h/tw)^-0.95 (L/ry)^-0.5 (1 - PG/Pye)^2.4 <= 0.07; b = 20 (h/tw)^-0.9 (L/ry)^-0.5 (1 - PG/Pye)^3.4 <= 0.07 (as printed); c = 0.4 - 0.4 PG/Pye; IO = 0.5a, LS = 0.75b, CP = b. Sec. C3.4a.2.b: elastic (force-controlled) where a = 0 or PG/Pye > 0.6. theta_y per Eq. C3-15 with M_CE, tau_b = 1 (PG/Pye <= 0.5).
column_flexure.decode_note: The converter flattened the Table C3.6 equations into digit strings ('5 5 1 0 07 0 95 0 5 2 4', '20 1 0 07 0 9 0 5 3 4', '0 4 0 4'); the expressions above are the consistent reading. The b cap prints as 0.07 (ASCE 41-17 used 0.15) -- CONFIRM against the PDF page 46 before relying on CP for columns. Row 2 (non-moderately ductile) could not be decoded; Ex22 columns are all highly ductile so it is not used.
column_flexure.note: PG = gravity axial (ASCE 41-23 Eq. 7-3 combination as applied by the tool); Pye = Ag Fye. L = unbraced length = storey height (L/ry, not 0.1 L/ry as in ASCE 41-17).

brace_axial.basis: HSS brace, concentrically braced frame -- phenomenological axial backbone (ASCE 41-17 Table 9-8 form, PLACEHOLDER from memory); deformations are multiples of delta_c (axial shortening at expected buckling) and delta_T (axial elongation at expected yield)

compression.note: linear interpolation between the stocky and slender limits on KL/r

brace_axial.element: corotTruss + Hysteretic (no pinching, no cyclic damage) -- monotonic pushover; cyclic deterioration to be added for NLRHA
brace_axial.note: UNVERIFIED placeholders. Retrieve AISC 342-22 brace modelling parameters / acceptance and AISC 341-22 Table A3.2 Ry (A500 Gr. C) and F2.3 expected brace strengths (RyFyAg; 1.14 Fcre Ag) through Query file manager before use.

gravity_for_pushover.note: ASCE 41 Sec. 7.2.2 Eq. 7-1 form; QL = 25% of the unreduced design live load. Prototype distributes each level's weight equally to that level's column nodes. Verify clause and factors.

nsp.load_pattern: first mode shape x mass (ASCE 41 Sec. 7.4.3.2.3)
nsp.note: BSE-1N spectrum = ASCE 7 design spectrum (SDS, SD1); BSE-2N = 1.5x (MCE_R). Performance check: LS at BSE-1N, CP at BSE-2N (BPON). Confirm Table 7-4/7-5 and Eq. 7-28..7-32 numbering in ASCE 41-23.
nsp.verified_against: ASCE/SEI 41-23 Sec. 7.4.3.2.5 (Ke at 0.6 Vy, bilinear balance), Eq. 7-28 Te, Eq. 7-29 delta_t, Eq. 7-30 C1 (a = 130 A/B, 90 C, 60 D/E/F; C1 = 1 for Te > 1.0 s), Eq. 7-31 C2 (= 1 for Te > 0.7 s), Eq. 7-32 mu_strength with Cm (Table 7-4: steel MF 3+ storeys 0.9; 1.0 if T > 1.0 s), Eq. 7-33 mu_max with h = 1 + 0.15 ln Te, Eq. 7-34 alpha_e with lambda = 0.8 (SX1 >= 0.6) / 0.2; Table 7-5 C0 (tool uses Gamma1*phi_roof per bullet 1); BSE-2N = MCE_R, BSE-1N = 2/3 BSE-2N (Sec. 2.3.1.1); BPON Table 2-5: RC IV -> IO at BSE-1N, LS at BSE-2N. Equation numbers in the tool's comments are the ASCE 41-17 numbering (one lower).

numerics.note: Ex22 modelling decision (tail-protocol rung 3, disclosed): the descent from Mc to the residual c*My is spread over 0.5a of hinge rotation instead of the default 0.15a (near-vertical). Reason: with 660 IMK hinges the near-vertical drop stopped the static solver at Vmax in both directions and produced non-convergence in the first Chapter 16 record (Imperial Valley Delta, 21 failed steps at 2% drift). The change eases the numerics; it does not alter a, b, c or the acceptance limits.

fema_p695.note: Omega = Vmax/V ; mu_T = delta_u / delta_y,eff with delta_y,eff = C0*(Vmax/W)*(g/4pi^2)*max(T,T1)^2 (FEMA P-695 Sec. 6.3).

compactness.note: AISC 341-22 Table D1.1 form (lambda_hd / lambda_md), Fye in place of Ry Fy, Ca = PG/Pye (AISC 342-22 Table C3.6 note [b]). Numeric limits are the AISC 341-22 Table D1.1 values as implemented in this tool -- AISC 341 was NOT in the converted set; re-verify with Query file manager.
